hook_text: Before it reaches your glass, your tap water has had a long trip. Want to follow it?
clip_script: The Vaal River at Vereeniging. Screens stop branches and plastic. Chemicals clump the mud into flocs, which sink in giant tanks. Sand filters catch the rest. A little chlorine kills the germs. Off to the taps! After you use it, down the drain, through the sewers, to the wastewater works. Screens, settling, and billions of hungry bacteria clean it again. Back to the river, for the next town downstream.
visual_style: Whiteboard loop from a river to a treatment works, a house with a tap, a sewer pipe, a wastewater works and back to the river.
pacing: River, works, tap, drain, works, river: one full loop.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and never flush a wet wipe.
